tb21_profile.skill: Recover a complete scrolling terminal transcript from a video: split it into frames with ffmpeg, OCR the text, stitch and de-duplicate overlapping frames into one ordered stream, then filter it down to just the lines the player typed at the prompt
tb21_profile.domain: ffmpeg frame extraction plus OCR (tesseract/vision), terminal text reconstruction, Zork/interactive-fiction command syntax
tb21_profile.task_form: recover-data-from-a-lossy-medium: extract exact ordered records from unstructured visual input, graded line-by-line against a reference

notes: The task splits into two sub-skills and the corpora cover them separately: TMax-15K owns the ffmpeg+OCR-a-terminal-recording half (dozens of genuine screen-recording OCR tasks, several never surfaced by the retrievers), while RTS and TerminalWorld own the filter-a-session-transcript-for-typed-commands half (the spoticli transcript family) and the Zork/interactive-fiction domain (text-adventure playthrough tasks). SWE-Smith has no video or OCR work; I used pdfplumber/pdfminer layout-aware text extraction and TextFSM terminal-output parsing, where the glyph-clustering and terminal-record-parsing skill really does transfer. SWE-Rebench is the weakest pool by a wide margin - only moviepy-1768 is genuinely on-topic and ranks 5-10 there are filler scored 1-2 accordingly.
